title: SustAInd
description: A software-centric framework for engineering sustainable AI-enabled systems.
collaboration: Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant, Anusandhan National Research Foundation
details: The project develops architecture-centric methods and tools for understanding and improving the sustainability of AI-enabled systems across their lifecycle.

title: GreenSAM
description: Approaches, frameworks, and tools for greening software deployments.
details: GreenSAM studies how deployment and architectural decisions can be measured and adapted to reduce avoidable environmental impact.

title: Agentic CloudOps
description: Agentic-AI-powered support for autonomous cloud operations.
details: The work examines how LLM-powered systems can support security, compliance, well-architected assessments, and operational recommendations with appropriate human oversight.

title: SA4S
description: Architecture-based approaches for sustainable data-intensive software systems.
details: SA4S investigates technical and environmental sustainability challenges in IoT and ML-enabled systems through the lens of software architecture and self-adaptation.

title: Model Switching
description: Improving edge-AI sustainability through runtime model switching.
collaboration: Qualcomm Edge AI Lab at IIIT Hyderabad
details: This work explores adaptation mechanisms that switch between machine-learning models according to changing quality-of-service and resource constraints.

title: VASARI
description: An Italian national project for digital and immersive cultural-heritage experiences.
details: Responsibilities included coordinating implementation architecture, documenting design decisions, integrating IoT devices, and developing backend prototypes for a multi-partner platform.

title: Python Virtual Labs
description: Interactive experiments for teaching advanced Python topics.
collaboration: Virtual Labs, Ministry of Education, Government of India
details: The project develops interactive learning experiments covering exception handling, complex data types, higher-order functions, lambda functions, and related concepts.
